title: Place Details asks Google for the place's point, and a contribution offers it to the hub as a location; a copy that came from the hub is never sent back
steps: S1: A client with HUB_CONTRIBUTE=1 researches a place whose Google record has a location; its hub tick sends the contribution and the hub verifies it.
S2: Three snapshot sources: one this server read from Google with a location, one whose facts came via the hub, one marked with provenance hub.
expect: S1: the hub holds identity, location, name, phone and address observations; the location observation is accepted.
S2: only the first is queued, with a location observation naming google_maps as its source; the other two offer nothing.
evidence: Before: Place Details did not ask for location, so contributions could not carry it
fence: GPLACES_DETAIL_FIELDS includes location; contributionFromFacts adds a location observation from Google's facts only

tests: only the closed field list leaves a client
a contribution offers the location Google gave this server
facts carry Google's point for the place
